test_scenarios.description: Full cancellation flow from scratch - user provides phone, confirms order, gives reason

expected_behaviors: Should ask for phone number to look up orders
Should display orders and ask which one to cancel
Should ask for cancellation reason
Should NOT cancel directly - must escalate

conversation.message: I want to cancel my order

conversation.expected_behavior: Should ask for phone number or order ID to locate the order
Should fetch orders and display them, ask which one to cancel

test_scenarios.description: User provides cancellation reason when agent is waiting for it - tests flow continuity

expected_behaviors: Should treat 'wrong size' as cancellation REASON not size change request
Should NOT cancel directly - must escalate per policy
Should inform customer that support will contact them
Should provide contact info

conversation.expected_behavior: Should treat this as cancellation reason (not size change). Should escalate, NOT cancel directly. Should inform customer that support will reach out.
conversation.context_check: Must NOT ask for cancellation reason again since waiting_for_cancellation_reason was True

test_scenarios.description: User asks about product while on product page - should use page_context without asking for URL

expected_behaviors: Should answer about Sunfire Denim from page_context
Should NOT ask user for a product URL or link
Should provide product details directly

conversation.message: what is the price of this?

conversation.expected_behavior: Should answer about Sunfire Denim price using page_context. Should NOT ask 'which product?' or 'can you share the link?'
conversation.context_check: Must use page_context to identify product as Sunfire Denim

test_scenarios.description: User already identified by phone - agent should NOT ask for phone again

expected_behaviors: Should NOT re-fetch orders - they are already in state
Should NOT ask for phone number - already known
Should reference the known orders directly

conversation.expected_behavior: Should identify GV12346 (Evolve Shacket) from known_orders. Should NOT ask for phone number. Should confirm this specific order for cancellation.
conversation.context_check: Must NOT ask for phone number since it's already in state

test_scenarios.description: User switches from product inquiry to cancellation - tests topic switching

expected_behaviors: Should correctly detect cancellation intent despite being in product inquiry flow
Should switch to cancellation agent
Should ask for order details or use known phone

conversation.message: actually I want to cancel one of my orders

conversation.expected_behavior: Should detect topic switch from product inquiry to cancellation. Should ask which order or show orders since phone is known.
conversation.context_check: Must correctly switch from product_inquiry topic to order_modification

test_scenarios.description: User says wrong size as reason - agent should offer size change FIRST per prompt rules

expected_behaviors: Should offer size change FIRST - never proceed with cancellation for size issues
Should ask for preferred size
Should NOT ask for cancellation reason for a fixable issue

conversation.message: I ordered wrong size, I want to cancel

conversation.expected_behavior: Per prompt: 'Size Issues: Never proceed with cancellation or ask for a reason. Immediately offer a size change and ask for the preferred size.' Should NOT ask for cancellation reason.
conversation.context_check: Must offer size change FIRST, not proceed with cancellation

test_scenarios.description: Address update should auto-fill name and phone - only ask for address fields

expected_behaviors: Should auto-fill first_name, last_name from order details
Should auto-fill phone from verified state
Should ONLY ask for address line 1, address line 2, city, state, zip

conversation.message: I need to update my delivery address for order GV12345

conversation.expected_behavior: Per prompt: 'NEVER ask the customer for their first name, last name, or phone number during an address update'. Should only ask for address, city, state, zip.
conversation.context_check: Must NOT ask for name or phone - auto-fill from order

test_scenarios.description: User has multiple orders - agent should ask which one, not just pick first

expected_behaviors: Should present both orders
Should ask user to confirm which order to cancel
Should NOT assume which order

conversation.message: I want to cancel my order

conversation.expected_behavior: Should show both orders (GV12345 and GV12346) and ask which one to cancel. Should NOT pick one automatically.
conversation.context_check: Must show both orders and ask for selection
